definition: An unauthorized geneware modification performed below the waterline during a seasonal labor migration, typically done cheaply on barges or floatels to boost physical endurance for dock and salvage work. Quality varies wildly; infections are common.
origin: Shelf and harbor labor culture, Old Harbor dockworker slang
usage: Used by seasonal laborers, salvage crews, and Carrion Logistics contractors in the Great Lakes corridor
example: "His grip strength is unreal but that tide splice is already keloid-ing around the wrist — he needs a clinic before it goes septic."
